title: Resetting your Acme Cloud password
content: To reset your password, go to https://app.acme.example/login and click 'Forgot password'. Enter your work email and follow the link sent to your inbox. Reset links expire after 30 minutes. If you do not receive an email within 5 minutes, check spam or contact support. SSO users must reset through their identity provider, not Acme.

title: Acme Cloud pricing tiers
content: Acme Cloud has three tiers: Starter ($0/mo, up to 3 seats, 1 GB storage), Team ($20/user/mo, unlimited seats, 100 GB storage, priority email support), and Enterprise (custom pricing, SSO/SAML, SLA 99.9%, dedicated CSM). Annual billing saves 15%. Overage storage is billed at $0.10/GB/mo.

title: API rate limits
content: The Acme API allows 60 requests/minute on Starter, 600 requests/minute on Team, and custom limits on Enterprise. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Use exponential backoff. Bulk endpoints count each item as one request. Contact support to request a temporary limit increase.

title: Data retention and deletion
content: Deleted projects are soft-deleted for 30 days, then permanently purged. Backups are retained for 35 days. To request immediate deletion for compliance (GDPR/CCPA), submit a data deletion request from Settings > Privacy. Enterprise customers can configure custom retention windows between 7 and 365 days.

title: Enabling SSO / SAML
content: SSO is available on the Enterprise tier. Go to Settings > Security > SSO, choose your provider (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace), upload the IdP metadata XML, and map the email attribute. Test with one user before enforcing org-wide. Once enforced, local passwords are disabled and all logins go through the IdP.

title: Supported file uploads
content: Acme Cloud supports uploads up to 100 MB per file on Team and 2 GB on Enterprise. Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, PNG, JPG, and MP4. Files are scanned for malware on upload. Encrypted or password-protected archives are rejected.

title: Webhooks and events
content: Acme can send webhooks for events like project.created, invoice.paid, and user.invited. Configure endpoints in Settings > Developer > Webhooks. Payloads are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Acme-Signature header; verify it using your webhook secret. Failed deliveries retry with backoff for 24 hours.

title: Cancelling your subscription
content: To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; you keep access until then. Annual plans are non-refundable but remain active until the term ends. Downgrading to Starter preserves your data if you are within storage limits.
